title: Jimmy Carter exposes the stealth program

tellings.quote: happened to Jimmy Carter when he was trying to get reelected. He mentioned the stealth

plain: In 1980, while Jimmy Carter was running for reelection, he is said to have mentioned the stealth program, the secret work on aircraft that radar cannot easily see, and something is said to have happened to him because of it. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this in passing, without naming a source, and he leaves it unclear what followed.
